item.title: MAN OF TOMORROW: James Gunn Reveals Massive Stack Of Storyboards And Teases Start Of Production
item.description: Man of Tomorrow director James Gunn has shared a huge stack of storyboards from his upcoming Superman sequel, confirming that pre-production is well underway. Plus, is that a first look at Brainiac?!

item.title: It Needs To Be Said: Marvel Studios Hit The Jackpot Casting Brie Larson As Captain Marvel
item.description: Much has been said about Brie Larson’s Captain Marvel, but the truth is, Marvel Studios is very fortunate to have gotten the actress to portray Carol Danvers.

item.title: WERWULF: Lily-Rose Depp Undergoes A Transformation Of Her Own In New Set Photos From Robert Eggers' Next Movie
item.description: We have some more photos from the set of Robert Eggers' Werwulf here, and they reveal a much better look at Aaron Taylor Johnson, as well as a first glimpse of Lily-Rose Depp...

item.title: MAN OF TOMORROW: Lex Luthor Actor Nicholas Hoult Confirms When Shooting Begins On The SUPERMAN Sequel
item.description: Superman and Peacemaker star Nicholas Hoult was recently asked what he could share about DC Studios and James Gunn's Man of Tomorrow, and the actor remained tight-lipped aside from one key confirmation.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: ACROSS THE SPIDER-VERSE’s Donald Glover Reveals He Had A Stroke; Had Surgery For Hole In His Heart
item.description: Donald Glover, who portrayed Aaron Davis in Spider-Man: Homecoming and Across the Spider-Verse, revealed serious health struggles that forced him to cancel his 2024 tour.

item.title: WICKED: FOR GOOD Takes Flight At Box Office, Breaks Own Record
item.description: Universal expected the Wicked sequel to open strong at the box office — but the film’s early numbers are surpassing even the studio’s most optimistic projections.

item.title: James Cameron Says He's Made An Unbreakable Promise To Get An ALITA: BATTLE ANGEL Sequel Made
item.description: Avatar filmmaker James Cameron revealed that he and Robert Rodriguez have a “blood oath” to make an Alita: Battle Angel sequel, and possibly even a third movie down the line.

item.title: WASP Actress Evangeline Lilly Praises THE WINTER SOLDIER On Instagram - Could She Be Teasing An MCU Return?
item.description: Wasp actress Evangeline Lilly took to Instagram to share praise for 2014’s Captain America: The Winter Soldier. Was it just a fun post, or could she be teasing her return to the MCU?

item.title: WICKED: FOR GOOD Cast And Crew Break Down Scarecrow And Tin Man Transformations As BTS Photos Reveal Designs
item.description: Wicked: For Good features two shocking transformations as a couple of Wicked's leads become Scarecrow and Tin Man from The Wizard of Oz. You can check out the final character designs and more here...

item.title: IT: WELCOME TO DERRY Spoilers: Episode 5 Finally Unleashes Pennywise The Clown After Show's Biggest Twist Yet
item.description: The fifth episode of It: Welcome to Derry, titled "29 Neibolt Street," finally unleashes Pennywise the Clown for a confrontation that turns the show on its head...and that's after a jaw-dropping return!
